sloka: मणिवरमुपगृह्य तं महार्हं जनकनृपात्मजया धृतं प्रभावात् ।गिरिरिव पवनावधूत्मुक्तः सुखितमनाः प्रतिसंक्रमं प्रपेदे ।। ५.३८.७३।।
transliteration: maṇivaramupagṛhya taṁ mahārhaṁ janakanṛpātmajayā dhṛtaṁ prabhāvāt ।giririva pavanāvadhūtmuktaḥ sukhitamanāḥ pratisaṁkramaṁ prapede ।। 5.38.73।।

translations.english: Having received the most precious jewel from the daughter of Janaka, Hanuman prepared to return like a mountain released from the impact of the wind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
